title.narrative: Pathways to Durable Solutions: Fostering Peaceful Coexistence and Sustainable Reintegration for IDPs in Iraq

description.narrative: The project aims to address internal displacement by facilitating voluntary, safe, and dignified solutions, focusing on Hassan Sham camps between Ninewa and Erbil. It also considers other priority displacement locations and key return areas (Kirkuk, Salaheddin, Diyala, Ninevah, and Anbar), specifically focusing on IDPs, returnees, and host communities. Aligned with IOM's 'Access to Solutions' approach, the project creates favorable conditions for the voluntary return, local (re)integration, or settlement of internally displaced persons (IDPs). Emphasizing social cohesion through a community stabilization approach, it seeks to foster peaceful coexistence, resolve tensions non-violently, restore trust in Local leadership, and empower communities for recovery. Prioritizing specific locations like Hassan Sham camps and key return areas, the project includes interventions such as Facilitated Voluntary Movement, Community Engagement, Livelihood Support, Housing, Infrastructure, Protection Services, Legal Support, and Mental Health and Psychosocial Support. The overarching goal is to enhance IDPs' well-being and living conditions in protracted displacement and returnees in areas of origin through integrated and targeted services."
